INSERT INTO resolution_templates (name, category, templateText, isDefault, createdBy, organizationId, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES
('Auto-Match Confirmed', 'unmatched', 'Transaction manually matched to counterpart record. Reference verified against source system. Match confirmed and exception closed.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Retry Scheduled', 'unmatched', 'Unable to match at this time. Retry scheduled for T+1. If unresolved after retry, escalate to operations team for manual investigation.', 0, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Counterparty Identified', 'missing_counterparty', 'Counterparty identified via phone/email verification. Payment applied to correct account. Alias added to Distributor Registry to prevent recurrence.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Pending Counterparty Confirmation', 'missing_counterparty', 'Counterparty identity unconfirmed. Notification sent to payer requesting correct reference. Exception held pending response within 48 hours.', 0, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Bank Fee Write-Off', 'amount_mismatch', 'Variance attributed to bank processing fee. Amount written off to Bank Charges GL account. Exception closed — no further action required.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Promotional Deduction Approved', 'amount_mismatch', 'Variance verified against approved promotional allowance budget. Credit note issued to counterparty. Exception closed.', 0, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Partial Payment Accepted', 'amount_mismatch', 'Partial payment accepted and applied. Outstanding balance recorded as arrears. Reminder notification sent to payer.', 0, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Late Payment Auto-Approved', 'timing_difference', 'Payment received outside settlement window but confirmed as legitimate. Auto-approved with late payment flag. Late payment notice issued.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Pending Settlement Confirmation', 'timing_difference', 'Transaction in pending state awaiting bank confirmation. Monitoring for 24 hours. Will auto-resolve on confirmation or escalate if unconfirmed.', 0, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Duplicate Reversed', 'duplicate_transaction', 'Duplicate payment identified and reversed. Original payment confirmed as settled. Counterparty notified of reversal. Exception closed.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Reversal Paired — Net Zero', 'reversal_unmatched', 'Original transaction and reversal successfully paired. Net financial impact: zero. Ledger unchanged. Exception closed.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Currency Conversion Applied', 'currency_mismatch', 'Currency mismatch resolved via prevailing CBN exchange rate. Variance posted to FX Revaluation GL. Exception closed.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
('Format Error — Resubmit', 'format_error', 'Transaction rejected due to format error in reference field. Sender notified to resubmit with correct format. Exception held pending resubmission.', 1, 1, NULL, NOW(), NOW());
